Plans break. Meetings get cancelled, projects fail, days go completely off script 💥
What matters is not how perfect the plan was, but how we respond when it falls apart.
Carl Pullein shares some practical advice for exactly those moments. Worth a read 👇

How do you handle it when your plans suddenly collapse?
